designer: internal (Collabera Digital AI Services Suite slide)
intent: Present six headline outcome metrics from a capability area as equal-weight stat blocks. Use when the audience needs to absorb numeric proof points fast (capability snapshot, post-engagement results, baseline/target gap).
invariants: exactly 6 stat cells laid out as a 3-column, 2-row grid
each cell has a thin vertical accent bar on the left edge (xs width)
vertical bars rotate through the theme palette (accent_1..accent_4 + accent_6) so each metric carries its own hue rather than one shared accent
value text uses the title type style and text_primary color
label text uses caption type style and text_secondary color
header bar with kicker and title sits above the metrics
a single sub-line caption introduces what the metrics represent
values are short tokens (number + unit, percentage, dollar amount, or duration)
variables: number of metrics (4-6, padded to fill the grid evenly)
header bar kicker and title text
accent rotation order (any palette ordering across cells)
